ns2:course.label: Innovation in E-Learning
ns2:course.description: Designed to provide an in-depth look at ongoing innovations in Web-based electronic technologies that can be used to deliver e-Learning content and to enhance learning experiences in e-Learning environments. Students will acquire and synthesize advanced content knowledge and critically review research on ongoing innovations that are integrated with targeted content in today's eCommunication and e-Learning environments. Prerequisite: Open to all graduate students.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Open to all graduate students.
